title: AnimalLauncher
description: A plugin that allows you to launch animals using shovels.
body:
# **The Animal Launcher**

## Use various levels of shovel to launch farm animals of different sizes!


### Wood
- Chickens
- Rabbits

### Stone
- Pig

### Iron
- Sheep

### Diamond + Netherite
- Cow


All launched animals will drop their respective cooked meat at the point of impact.

Just a quick for fun plugin, no plans to add additional features, configs or permissions at this time. Maybe if the plugin picks up enough traction i'll look at fully developing it.
